# Every tool a test requires is listed here, even if the image already has it.
# Virtual display for the window test.
xvfb
xauth
# libxkbcommon-x11.so, loaded by the window under X11.
libxkbcommon-x11-0
# Compressors the write tests call to produce .gz, .xz, .zst images.
gzip
xz-utils
zstd
# Reference tools that read back what `bonk format` writes.
gdisk
dosfstools
exfatprogs
